equivalent_original.purpose: Alternate encoding of the same original, preserved and not presented as additional evidence.

purpose: One contiguous narrow excerpt retaining the Botões ícone heading, outlined/filled button state examples and the complete Área de clique diagram. Removes empty right-hand documentation space so both states and touch-area evidence can be examined inside the smallest mobile page, without a raw-image link.
transparency: Original RGBA files are untouched. All pixels inside this crop are opaque; decoded output RGBA matches the source crop exactly, including alpha. No background was flattened or invented.
transform: Pillow Image.open(source).crop((35, 560, 208, 823)).save(output, lossless=True, exact=True); no resize, montage or retouching
context_preserved: Full icon-button section heading, component-final label, all outlined and filled examples inside their dashed bounds, accessibility heading and complete annotated touch-area diagram; only surrounding whitespace is removed.
limits: The raster excerpt demonstrates documented states and touch areas, not accessibility certification, production interaction behavior, or Harmony implementation. Source labels remain in Portuguese; the page explanation is English.
